claim: Le Calandre is at Via Liguria 1, Sarmeola di Rubano (PD) and holds three Michelin stars in the 2026 Italia guide.
quote: Le Calandre – Rubano - a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant. Address: Via Liguria 1, I-35030, Sarmeola di Rubano, Padova (Veneto). Three Stars in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia.

claim: Le Calandre is operated by the Alajmo family and is part of Relais & Châteaux.
quote: Ristorante Le Calandre | Fine dining restaurant Sarmeola di Rubano, Padova | Relais & Châteaux

claim: Hotel Maccaroni is a 34-room 3-star adjacent to Le Calandre, with the Il Calandrino bakery on-site, connected to the Alajmo culinary world.
quote: Hotel Maccaroni... small 3-star hotel... 34 comfortable rooms... just steps away from the Michelin-starred Le Calandre restaurant... pastry shop and snack bar (Il Calandrino) within the building

claim: Hotel Le Calandre (same Sarmeola di Rubano address as Maccaroni) is a 3-star with clean rooms but dark décor and basic breakfast; next door to the restaurant.
quote: simple, good standard 3-star hotel with clean and comfortable rooms, though the décor is a little dark... Breakfast is quite basic but certainly good enough... next door to the restaurant

claim: Hotel El Rustego in Rubano was created from the restoration of a 19th-century manor villa and sits on the Padova–Vicenza road, 7 km from Padova.
quote: Hotel El Rustego arose from the restructuring of a 19th-century manor villa, located in Rubano near Padova... preserves a rustic character... 7 km from Padova

claim: Belludi 37 is a 16-room boutique between Prato della Valle and the Basilica of St. Anthony with mid-century-inspired furniture, arrival prosecco, and no elevator; rates from ~€205.
quote: chic, intimate boutique hotel in historic Padua... 16 guest rooms... mid-century-inspired furniture, vivid purple rugs and luxe shag carpets... prosecco and Venetian biscuits upon arrival... biggest drawback is that it doesn't have an elevator

claim: Belludi 37 is the flagship of the Collezione Belludi micro-brand in Padova.
Majestic Hotel Toscanelli is a boutique 4-star occupying a 1500s building in Padova's Ghetto, 100 m from Piazza delle Erbe, in a ZTL limited-traffic zone.
quote: boutique hotel positioned in Padua's historic center, specifically in the 'Ghetto' district... occupies a historic structure dating to the 1500s... steps away from three famous squares: Piazza delle Erbe, Piazza della Frutta, and Piazza dei Signori... Situated in a limited-traffic zone

claim: Methis Hotel & Spa is a 4-star design hotel on the Naviglio canal at the edge of Padova's historic centre with floors themed around earth, fire, water, and air and an in-house spa with sauna and Turkish bath.
quote: rooms are inspired by the four elements – earth, fire, water and air – from the heaviest and most material element, earth, on the first floor, to the most ethereal one, air, on the fourth floor... Set on the banks of the Naviglio River... spa centre... sauna and Turkish bath

claim: Hotel Bellavista Terme is a Relais & Châteaux property in Montegrotto Terme with thermal-mud treatments and multiple thermal pools.
quote: Hotel Bellavista Terme, a Relais Chateaux near Venice... Thermal mud treatments and spa services, Multiple pools and Jacuzzi facilities... Via dei Colli, 5, 35036 Montegrotto Terme

claim: Bellavista Terme scores 7.3/10 across 591 verified Booking reviews, with staff at 8.3 and value-for-money at 6.8.
quote: rated 7.3 out of 10 by Booking.com guests based on 591 verified reviews... 8.3 for staff... 6.8 for value for money

claim: Relais Villa Giulia in Mestrino is built into restored barns adjacent to a 17th-century Venetian villa, 12 rooms + 2 apartments, 4.8/5 on TripAdvisor with Travelers' Choice.
quote: obtained from the total restoration of two ancient barns adjacent to a Venetian villa of the '600... 12 rooms plus two apartments... 4.8 out of 5 rating across 18 reviews... #1 of 3 small hotels in Mestrino... Travelers' Choice

claim: Hotel Donatello is a 19th-century building directly opposite the Basilica of St. Anthony with 44 rooms (some with Basilica views) but dated bathrooms.
quote: Donatello Hotel, built in the 19th century, is located in the historic center in front of Saint Anthony's Church... 44 furnished rooms... some with a view on the Basilica... bathroom could use a renovation

claim: Rubano to Padova is ~9 km, ~10–15 min by taxi at €17–25; bus line 10 is the public-transit alternative.
quote: taxi from Rubano to Padova is 5.7 miles and takes 11 minutes, costing $20–25

claim: Padova station to Rubano by taxi takes ~10 min at €17–21.
quote: fastest way to get from Padova Station to Rubano is by taxi, which takes 10 minutes and costs $17-$21

claim: Padova has 24/7 night taxi dispatch via TaxiPadova (+39 049 651333), useful for late returns from a Le Calandre tasting menu.
quote: TaxiPadova offers an efficient night service, thanks to an automated system that connects all taxis in service 24/7
